m2-attest-guard.title: Report-only basis guard in attest()
m2-attest-guard.imperative: Add `_resolve_basis_locator(cl, base_dir, basis) -> str | None` (file: resolve against base_dir, glob-aware; evidence_ref: pure read of cl['tasks']). Thread a new `base_dir: Path | None = None` param into `attest()` and into the `_run_verb` CLI dispatch call site. Inside the existing `if chk is None:` branch, before the unconditional accept: if basis absent or abstain, skip; else resolve, always `attach()` a `basis-check` evidence item `{locator_kind, locator, resolved, problem}` regardless of outcome, then fall through to the unchanged unconditional accept (report-only, never raise). TDD: write the red-proof tests first (no-basis unchanged, file-missing report-only pass + resolved:false evidence, file-present report-only pass + resolved:true evidence, abstain behaves like no-basis, evidence_ref locator resolving against a sibling task condition), observe them fail, then implement until green.
